About the Venue

A grand setting for your biggest days

The Grand Event Complex is a marquee and banquet venue in Ichhra, Lahore, located on the main Lahore–Kasur Road in Shershah Colony. It hosts wedding functions and private celebrations for gatherings of up to 200 guests.

From the Barat and Walima to Mehndi nights, Nikah ceremonies, birthdays and corporate events, the venue brings everything under one roof — in-house catering for your guests and on-site parking for their convenience.

Rated 4.4 stars from 270 reviews, it is a trusted celebration address for families across Ichhra and greater Lahore.

Celebrations We Host

Events at the Complex

One elegant venue for every occasion — wedding functions, family celebrations and business gatherings alike.

Barat

The main wedding celebration — a decorated stage, full seating for your guests and in-house catering for the big day.

Walima

A graceful reception dinner to host family and friends, with seating for up to 200 guests and catering arranged in-house.

Nikah

An intimate, dignified setting for the Nikah ceremony, with close family gathered in one elegant hall.

Mehndi

A colourful, joyful evening of music and celebration — the hall is yours to dress in your Mehndi theme.

Birthdays

Milestone birthdays and family parties with room for up to 200 guests, catering on site and parking at the door.

Corporate Events

Company dinners, gatherings and functions in a formal banquet setting, with in-house catering for your team and guests.
